name: Misakura Kanata
source:
She has a bright and slightly silly personality, or to put it another way, she's overly straightforward and pure. She possesses an almost fatally positive thinking ability, and no matter what happens, after experiencing sadness and distress, she has a mental structure (like a canine) that makes her think, "Oh well," or "This is fine as it is." She's always positive and believes she's thinking things through carefully, with a policy of "doing what needs to be done" and "doing things properly." She has a strong sense of responsibility, and while being called stupid and laughed at doesn't bother her, she feels pain when she can't do anything for someone else. She seems to find supreme joy in "being able to do something for someone else," and in a sense, "work" is her calling. She has a face that looks a little younger than her age. She is a virgin. She has a flat chest.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150903004157/http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/candytoys]official site, archived[/url]]
